settings.title: A site that doesn't let you down.

settings.editor: Fast, monitored hosting on Perth servers we look after ourselves. If something's off, we're usually already on it.

settings.title: Which hosting is right for you?

settings.editor: Every plan runs on Perth servers we monitor ourselves, with free migration and local support. New to cPanel? It's the dashboard you use to manage your site, email and files.

icon_list.text: Free migration from your current host

settings.editor: We handle the updates, security and monitoring, so you don't have to. Semi-managed means we look after the technical upkeep of your site, you just run the business.

icon_list.text: Updates, security and monitoring handled for you
Free migration from your current host

settings.editor: Looking for reseller hosting, or need a private server (VPS)? Dedicated and VPS hosting is coming soon. Join the waitlist.

settings.title: What's included, no matter which plan.

settings.editor: The padlock in the browser bar, set up for you on every site.
We move your files, databases and email across from your current host.
Your site is backed up offsite every 6 hours, so nothing's lost for long.
Call a Perth number and talk to the team that runs the servers.

settings.title: Not sure what you need? We'll figure it out with you.

settings.editor: Getting online shouldn't mean learning how servers work first. Tell us a bit about your business and we'll walk you through exactly what you need: hosting, a domain, email, or all three. Then we set it up, so you don't have to.
Here's what business owners say after switching.

tabs.tab_title: Should I choose cPanel or WordPress hosting?
tabs.tab_content:
cPanel hosting gives you the dashboard (cPanel) to manage your site, email and files yourself. Semi-managed WordPress hosting is for WordPress sites where we handle the updates, security and monitoring, so you don't have to.

Not sure? Talk to our Perth team and we'll point you the right way.

tabs.tab_title: Can you move my website from my current host?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. Migration is free on every plan. We move your files, databases and email across, and most sites move with no downtime.
Yes. You can switch plans any time as you grow.
No lock-in contracts. Monthly plans can be cancelled any time, and yearly plans come with a 30-day money-back guarantee.

settings.title: Switching is easier than you think.

settings.editor: We migrate your files, databases and email for free. Most sites move across with no downtime.
